# Prompt Info

> Prompt Info is a browser-based model usage cost calculator built by Jonathan R. Reed through Hello.World Consulting. It estimates a request, multi-turn session, and recurring workload from a checked pricing source before a request reaches a provider.

The estimates are planning values, so a provider invoice will not match them line for line.

## Key Pages

- [Cost Calculator](https://prompt-info.helloworldfirm.com/): Estimate request, session, monthly, and annual model usage across the priced models in the active source.
- [Format Comparison](https://prompt-info.helloworldfirm.com/format-comparison/): Compare the token footprint of JSON, YAML, XML, CSV, and TOON.
- [Token Efficiency](https://prompt-info.helloworldfirm.com/token-efficiency/): Compare cost per completed task; a cheaper per-token model that emits more tokens can cost more overall.
- [About and references](https://prompt-info.helloworldfirm.com/about/): Product scope, methodology, and technical references.
- [Contact](https://prompt-info.helloworldfirm.com/contact/): Product questions, bug reports, and pricing corrections.
- [Privacy](https://prompt-info.helloworldfirm.com/privacy/): Data-boundary notes for prompt handling and support requests.
- [Sitemap](https://prompt-info.helloworldfirm.com/sitemap.xml): Every indexable URL on the site.
- [Full pricing listing](https://prompt-info.helloworldfirm.com/llms-full.txt): Every priced model with input and output price per million tokens, context window, and output limit, plus the arithmetic the calculator uses. Generated at build.
- Shareable estimates: `/?models=<id,id>&tokens=<n>&out=<n>&turns=<n>&mode=baseline|scenario&runs=<n>&cadence=once|day|week|month` opens the calculator with those assumptions and no prompt text. `/?model=<openrouter slug>` preselects one model.

## Policies

- [robots.txt](https://prompt-info.helloworldfirm.com/robots.txt): The authoritative machine-readable version of everything below (Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no, use=reference).
- **search = yes.** Indexing this site and returning links or short excerpts is permitted.
- **ai-input = yes.** Using this content as real-time grounding or retrieval input for a generative answer is permitted when the answer cites and links back to the source page.
- **ai-train = no.** Using this content to train or fine-tune a model is not permitted. This is an express reservation of rights under Article 4 of EU Directive 2019/790.

Crawlers refused in robots.txt include GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended,
Applebot-Extended, meta-externalagent, CCBot, Bytespider, Amazonbot, AI2Bot,
cohere-ai, anthropic-ai, claude-web, Diffbot, ImagesiftBot, and omgili.
Search and answer-engine crawlers (Googlebot, Bingbot, OAI-SearchBot,
Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Amzn-SearchBot, meta-webindexer, Applebot)
and user-initiated fetchers remain allowed.

## Data Boundaries

- Prompt text stays in browser memory for cost planning and format comparison.
- Pricing data uses a same-origin pricing API when available and a bundled model catalog as fallback.
- Do not paste API keys, customer records, unreleased launch material, or confidential transcripts into a public browser utility.
